title: Endif Bot Challenge
wikitext:
The idea behind this challenge is to play a three-minute midair duel in endif against a level 10 bot and getting as many frags as possible. [[Trygve]] originally came up with the idea of getting 200-0 against the bot, and the challenge was then extended from there. ==Settings== 
KT2 respawns
timelimit: 3
powerups: on
midair: on
bot skill: 10
